notes.content:
Condition 1 — 2.$5 is not empty

Company Name must be filled in. Stops leads with no company.

Condition 2 — 2.$3 contains @

Email Address must look like an actual email. Stops garbage or empty email fields.

Condition 3 — 2.$7 is not empty

Message must be filled in. Stops the empty "ghost" submissions you were seeing in your inbox.

All three must be true at the same time ("and") for the lead to pass through to webCRM. Any submission that fails even one of these conditions gets silently dropped.
